title: Reconcile diverged Pilobol.us build.py: effects work vs deploy branch

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Two copies of /web/build.py have diverged and BOTH have something the other needs. Neither is a superset. Do not blindly take either side.

COPY A - Pilobol.us main branch, commit c9a8823 (rescued from untracked; was committed nowhere before today):
  + the generative effects work: physarum-v17/v5, reaction-diffusion, cellular-automata, background-manager, cinematic-gallery, organic-image, the effects/ pages, sample imagery, pilobil-theme-v10.css (~5,200 lines)
  + an 'Effects Index' nav item
  - still says 'Pilobil.us' - the SUPERSEDED spelling. Decided name is Pilobol.us (see PPY-17fcfc: 'The public domain is pilobol.us ... do not relitigate').
  - NO theme-toggle script
  - NEVER copies assets/ or css/ into dist/ - so a clean build from this copy yields HTML with no styles and no JS
  - globally un-escapes < > " in Markus output - see PPY-2d0e52, must not survive reconciliation

COPY B - Pilobol.us-worktrees/PPY-17fcfc-static-hosting, branch cursor/feature/PPY-17fcfc-amplify-static-3af6 (what production deploys):
  + correct 'Pilobol.us' spelling throughout
  + theme-toggle script (verified working in a browser: data-theme flips, localStorage 'pilobil-theme' persists across navigation)
  + DOES copy assets/ and css/ into dist/ (lines ~124-130)
  + has amplify.yml
  - NONE of the effects work

CONSEQUENCE OF THE MISSING COPY STEP: I ran copy A's build.py. It emitted 20 files, but dist/assets/ still contained a STALE physarum-v8.js while background-manager.js requests physarum-v17.js, which was never copied. The effect is broken in that build output. dist only looked right because earlier one-shot scripts had hand-copied files into it. Copy A's dist is not reproducible from copy A's build.py.

TARGET: one build.py with copy B's correctness (name, theme toggle, asset/css copy, amplify.yml) PLUS copy A's effects, and WITHOUT the unescape hack - replace it per PPY-2d0e52 option (b): put effect scaffolding in the trusted page shell and let Markdown only name the effect to mount.

ACCEPTANCE: rm -rf web/dist && python3 web/build.py produces a complete, correct site - styles present, physarum-v17 present and loading, theme toggle working, 'Pilobol.us' spelling throughout - with no manual file copying.
